title: An historical and moral view of the origin and progress of the French Revolution; and the effect it has produced in Europe
author: Mary Wollstonecraft

authorInfo.bio: Mary Wollstonecraft 27 April 1759 – 10 September 1797) was an English writer and philosopher best known for her advocacy of women's rights. Until the late twentieth century, Wollstonecraft's life, which encompassed several unconventional personal relationships, received more attention than her writing. Wollstonecraft is regarded as one of the founding feminist philosophers, and feminists often cite both her life and her works as important influences.

description: "An Historical and Moral View of the Origin and Progress of the French Revolution" by Mary Wollstonecraft is a historical account written in the late 18th century. The book explores the complex political, social, and moral ramifications of the French Revolution, delving into the ideas that shaped its development and the consequences it wrought upon France and Europe at large.
